items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I have some friends from Homestead -- in fact some very dear friends of mine. One of the Braudeses there was married to Wellman Braud and from what I could understand, he was from New York?

ctx.x: Yeah, Gene Cedric was with Fats Waller (Unintelligible)

That's right and Edward Barksdale on Guitar, Sidney Bechet, but I think Sidney was with Cafe Society for a while and so did Sidney de Paris and Wilbur de Paris and Wellman Braud on bass and Eddie Dougherty on drums.
Was Wellman Braud from Washington also because he was an early Ellingtonian.
